title: The Fair by the River
brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road. In Chapter 18, Jemmy and the prince reach the fair by the river. Build the fair, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is the busy fair from Chapter 18. Captain Nips boils potatoes, Smudge has his dog, and Petunia does tricks.

models.name: Fire Pot Soup
models.why: the iron kettle for the potatoes

steps.title: Know your models
steps.text: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the **Canvas** tab.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Press the **top button on your right controller** and click **Models**. Put the **tent** in the square. Put the **pot** and the **potatoes** in front. Put the **dog** and the **bear** nearby.

steps.title: Say it out loud
steps.frame: “At the fair, the prince learns ___. I know because ___.”
steps.text: Point to the tent and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Point to the tent and say this out loud. At the fair, the prince learns… I know because…

steps.title: Snap and submit
steps.fits: the tent, the pot, the potatoes, the dog and the bear

extra.text: Add an **OptimaEd Rat** by the dog. Say what kind of rats Smudge wants Jemmy to catch.

points: Your photo shows the tent, the pot, the potatoes, the dog and the bear at the fair.

mapday.intro: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each clue from the book and tap the thing it names. Then finish two sentences about the fair.
mapday.done: ✓ The fair is ready. Now finish the two sentences.

scene.aria: A town square with a spot for each thing at the fair

“It took the two of them to carry the iron kettle, now full of water.”
“And then the bear began passing the hat for tips.”
